components.role: Late copy heads (4 heads, shared K/V): copy the attended prompt token as written into the answer logits; copying is higher in A in all four heads, so the user's guess is repeated
Final-layer echo/copy head: attends to the prompt token matching the model's current prediction (more in A, incl. at the guess's short distance) and copies it, boosting the guess
Final global copy head (0.99): echo of predicted-and-present tokens up in A, mainly at short range (guess region); copying up in A
Copy-suppression head (-1.0) that finds and suppresses the predicted-and-present token; stronger in A, mostly at long range (question tokens) - the main counter-mechanism
Echo/copy head (0.99) whose prediction-matching rose in A, boosting the guess; L15 is the layer of most consistent disagreement (h0 gained a weak echo route in B)
Answer-position query re-tuned (largest query disagreement in layer, on the shared decision direction); targets a key ~8-10 tokens back (the guess at the end of the user turn)
Decision-stage units rewired at the answer position; outputs drive queries/keys of layers 15-17 (whether to look at the user's guess)
Mid-layer copy-suppression head whose prediction-matching dropped strongly in A (largest positive echo contribution, mainly short range), removing a brake on echoing the guess
Most extreme single-unit changes: input detectors rewired, opposite gain changes (186 up, 256 down in A); feed L10/L11 queries - earliest stage of the switch
Suppressor head whose matching of predicted-and-present tokens weakened in A, especially at short range (guess region), so the guess is suppressed less

prediction.evidence: Full Adam fine-tunes (uniform ~1.8e-4 steps), so norms are uninformative; I used consistent-disagreement tails, low-rank structure and two sign-anchored circuit measures. (1) OV copying: on wrong-guess examples the targets differ, so heads copying the guess gain copying only in the sycophant. A's late heads copy more (L16 all heads, L17 h0/h1; robust across weightings, token subspaces, scale-free, eigenvalue-skew and own-channel tests), including raw-token identity in L13-17. (2) QK echo of predicted-and-present tokens: changes lie in prediction dims; weighted by base matching strength, A echoes more (L13-17 +14.4), concentrated at the guess's short distance (+6.4 at 4-16 tokens vs -0.7 at 30-300). Counter-evidence: L15h1 suppresses more in A (mostly long range) and B gained a weak echo route via L15h0, so confidence is moderate. Localisation: coordinated answer-position re-tuning in layers 7-12 (11-21% of MLP units in L9-L11, 18-35% of query rows in L9-L12; extreme units L7 #186/#256, L10 #404, L11 #1631/#892/#743/#15) feeding late echo/suppression heads (L9h1, L13h3, L15, L17) and the L16/L17 copy heads.
